text:
Hello there, hunter!
What can I do for you?
zh:
你好啊，猎手！
有什么能为你效劳的？

text: Where do you get your bows from?
zh: 你的弓都是从哪儿来的？

text:
All my bows are my own craft.
I only use the best wood for these.
zh:
我的弓全是我亲手做的。
用的都是最好的木料。

text: You won't find better bows anywhere else, I promise you that. I have spent a lifetime perfecting my technique.
zh: 我向你保证，别处你找不到比这更好的弓。我花了一辈子打磨我的手艺。
